newsitem.title: UK: Ryland says in talks over possible offer.
newsitem.headline: Ryland says in talks over possible offer.

text.p: British retail motor trade and leasing firm Ryland Plc said on Friday it was in talks which could lead to an offer for the company.
"The board of Ryland announces that it is in discussions which may or may not lead to an offer for the entire share capital of the company," Ryland said in a statement.
It gave no further details. The company reported pretax profit of 3.6 million pounds in the year to April 30, 1996 on turnover of 313.8 million.
Ryland shares were up 23 pence to 102-1/2 at 1521 GMT.
